subject: Phased intake: stability gate, escrow, and ingress schedule for Helios-Lite variants
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@quantumapp.com>
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Phased intake: stability gate, escrow, and ingress schedule for Helios-Lite variants

Team —

QuantumApp just handed over a new series of Helios-Lite variants (v1.3/v1.4) for production evaluation. They want a fast path but we should treat this as a phased intake with a temporary escrow and clear stability gates. Key asks from my side: 

- Temporary variant escrow (pin) for v1.3 while we run the compatibility matrix and telemetry baseline.
- Canary schedule with progressive ingress limits (5% -> 25% -> 75%) and telemetry gating at each step.
- Explicit fallback mapping to the existing Helios-stable variant if quality/regression triggers fire.
- A list of mandatory compatibility checks (tokenizer, KV cache behavior, batching jitter) and ownership for each check.

I attached a first-pass compatibility matrix and a telemetry sample. Can Priyom take point on the compatibility tests, Laura on rollout windows and canary wiring, Monica on policy/Escrow paperwork, and Hannah on safety/strike criteria?

Sanjay, for visibility: we can do a provisional pin for v1.3 for two weeks while we complete tests; can you confirm whether you can supply an updated tokenizer artifact and a performance micro-benchmark for 512/1024 token sequences by Friday?

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Product Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@quantumapp.com>
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phased intake: stability gate, escrow, and ingress schedule for Helios-Lite variants

Rishi —

I can own the compatibility checklist. Quick notes after a skim of the matrix: 

- Tokenizer: primary risk is token-id mismatch for a rare control token sequence. I'll run a token-span diff across our reference corpus and QuantumApp's artifact. Owner: Priyom (ETA 48h).
- KV cache: memory layout looks consistent, but we need a synthetic multi-session replay to validate eviction determinism. Owner: Priyom/Infra (ETA 72h).
- Batching and latency tail: need 1000 sample traces for cold-start to confirm batching heuristics. Owner: Priyom + Observability (ETA 96h).

I'll start the token diffs today and upload results to the intake doc. If any of these fail, propose we hold the provisional pin until mitigations are in place.

—Priyom

Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phased intake: stability gate, escrow, and ingress schedule for Helios-Lite variants

Hi Rishi / team —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers from my side: 

- Tokenizer artifact: attached (helios_tokenizer_v1.3.tok) and we also included a token-map.csv (see attachment stub).
- Perf micro-benchmarks: I ran 512 and 1024 token runs on a p4d-equivalent profile and attached the summary (helios_perf_v1.3.csv). 512 median latency is +8% vs your Helios-stable baseline, 99th is +12%.
- For the two-week provisional pin: we agree to keep a read-only escrow (no customer-facing promotion) and a rollback window if regressions appear.

We can also make a minor tune (reduce context window weighting) if the telemetry shows systematic tail regressions during batching. Tell me which telemetry hooks you need and we’ll add them to the next artifact drop.

Cheers,
Sanjay

--
Sanjay Mehta
Head of Platform Engineering
QuantumApp
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phased intake: stability gate, escrow, and ingress schedule for Helios-Lite variants

All —

Thanks Sanjay + team. Proposed rollout cadence (given the perf delta):

- Day 0 (provisional): Read-only escrow + staging ingress at 0.5% for smoke.
- Day 2–4: Canary 5% with strict telemetry checks (see gating list below).
- Day 6–9: Canary 25% if no gating triggers.
- Day 10–14: Raise to 75% and run extended latency/quality sweeps, then decide full promotion.

Gating signals (any one triggers immediate rollback to Helios-stable):
- 99th latency > baseline + 20% for 30m window.
- Regression in top-5 answer-rate on the 1k eval prompt-set (we'll run nightly).
- Memory-leak or KV-eviction anomalies observed in multi-session replays.

Action items assigned: 
- Priyom: token diff + KV deterministic replay (ETA 72h).
- Monica: finalize escrow paperwork and provisional pin (ETA EOD Thu).
- Hannah: provide exact eval prompt-set and pass/fail thresholds (ETA 24h).
- Rishi: confirm canary routing knobs and rollback playbook.

Laura

On Wed, May 2, 2028 at 08:21 AM Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@quantumapp.com> wrote:

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@quantumapp.com>
Date: Fri, 5 May 2028 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phased intake: stability gate, escrow, and ingress schedule for Helios-Lite variants

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps: 

1) Provisional decisions (approved):
- Create a read-only escrow and provisional pin for Helios-Lite v1.3 for 14 days. Monica, proceed with paperwork and set access to read-only.
- Begin token diffs and KV deterministic replays immediately (Priyom). If Priyom flags any break, we hold the pin.
- Canary schedule agreed as Laura outlined. Hannah to push the 1k eval prompt-set and define the quality thresholds by EOD Monday.

2) Fallback and automation:
- Automatic rollback trigger will be a webhook from Observability to the routing layer (we'll use the existing canary-fail hook). Priyom + Laura to validate the hook on Day 0.

3) Deliverables and owners: 
- Priyom: token diffs, KV replay, batching traces (deliver to intake doc).
- Laura: canary runbook + ingress knobs.
- Monica: escrow + provisional pin in HubSpot reference DEAL-9832.
- Hannah: eval prompt-set and thresholds.
- Rishi: consolidate post-mortem template and ownership for the rollback runbook.

Sanjay — please upload the tokenizer and perf artifacts to the intake doc (links above) so Priyom can start. If we hit blockers, I'll escalate to Platform lead.

I'll open a short Slack channel to coordinate the Day 0 run.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Product Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference
